name: Holly
source:
Holly dreams of making it big as a model. She has tried out on a few shoots, but always seems to end up naked.

As a wannabe model, Holly adores dress-up and cosplay.

She has a passion for photography and is never too far from a selfie, but her love of nudity can often get her into big trouble.

She is super close to her sister, [url=/c105859]Louise[/url], the pair share everything.

Holly is often too trusting, and easily manipulated. But don't be fooled - she has a dark, daring side.

[From [url=https://dumbkoala.art/MeetTheCast/info.php?name=Holly]DumbKoala[/url]]
